sofia_finance: FYI vendor Mica Software submitted invoice INV-2219. It references PO PO-98765 but the vendor put cost center CC-42 while our PO is tied to CC-77. Routing failed — approver not found. Anyone seen this pattern?
devon_ops: Can you drop the invoice and PO PDF here? quick screenshot of PO header helps.
sofia_finance: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/finance/invoices/INV-2219.pdf and PO snapshot. PO header shows: 
```
PO: PO-98765
Requestor: Platform Infra
Cost center: CC-77
```
Invoice shows: Cost center: CC-42 (old mapping). Vendor note: "legacy billing - please match to PO."
marco_ap: AP system tried auto-match to PO-98765 by number, but our routing uses cost center->approver mapping. CC-42 is unmapped so workflow dropped to exceptions queue. Invoice ID INV-2219 now in AP exceptions.
ap_bot: Automated: Invoice INV-2219 placed in exceptions queue due to unmapped cost center CC-42. Next action: manual approval required. Link: https://ap.redwood.com/exceptions/INV-2219
sofia_finance: Is manual match + code to CC-77 acceptable or do we need vendor to reissue? This is a monthly committed charge for Redwood Dedicated capacity.
priya_fm: If goods/services align (they do), approve manual match to CC-77 to avoid delaying payment. We should also ask vendor to correct future invoices.
marco_ap: I can do manual match/approve if finance confirms GL and approver. Confirm GL string?
sofia_finance: GL: 5402-PLATFORM-INFRA. Approver should be @devon_ops (requestor owner) or Priya. Devon, are you OK to be approver?
devon_ops: Yep, I'm ok to approve. I'll jump into AP queue and route. :thumbsup:
marco_ap: Done — I manually coded to CC-77 / GL 5402-PLATFORM-INFRA and routed to @devon_ops. AP system shows status: Pending Approval (Devon).
ap_bot: Automated: Approver notification sent to devon_ops.
devon_ops: Approved. Marked paid terms net-30. :white_check_mark:
sofia_finance: Thanks. I'll email Mica to request corrected future invoices with the right cost center and include the vendor SOP. Raising a quick PO-mapping doc update so CC-42 is flagged as deprecated.
priya_fm: Add a note to vendor master: 'use CC-77 for Dedicated/Platform' and follow up in next vendor review.
sofia_finance: Created ticket FIN-3427 to update vendor master and mapping. Link: https://issues.redwood.com/FIN-3427. Closing thread once vendor confirms. :eyes:
